2607.19297.title: Graph-Based Agentic AI with LangGraph: Workflow Pathways for Long-Running Stateful Business Processes
2607.19297.paper_summary: This paper is a practitioner guide to graph-based workflow pathways for long-running, stateful, multi-step generative AI systems in business processes. Rather than treating LangGraph, a low-level orchestration framework for stateful agents, as a model-quality benchmark target, we present three executable recipes -- SQL analytics with repair loops, agentic retrieval-augmented generation with evidence gating, and human-in-the-loop policy review with interrupt and checkpoint recovery -- to show how typed state, conditional routing, deterministic tools, retries, interrupts, checkpoints, and traces fit together. LangGraph is positioned by workflow-complexity fit, not as a universal default: simpler ReAct-style or plain SDK loops may be better for basic tool use, schema-first tools for structured extraction and validation, and DSPy when prompt or program optimization is the main goal. Each recipe explains when LangGraph is worth the extra structure and which implementation patterns make routes, pauses, and audit trails explicit product behavior rather than hidden prompt logic.
2607.19297.paper_summary_zh: 這篇論文是針對長時間運行、有狀態的多步驟生成式 AI 系統在商業流程中的基於圖的工作流程路徑的實務指南。<lb/>我們不將 LangGraph，這個針對有狀態代理的低階協調框架，視為模型品質基準目標，而是提出三個可執行的配方——帶有修復迴圈的 SQL 分析、帶有證據閘的代理檢索增強生成，以及帶有中斷和檢查點恢復的人類參與政策審查——以展示類型狀態、條件路由、確定性工具、重試、中斷、檢查點和追蹤如何相互配合。<lb/>LangGraph 的定位是根據工作流程的複雜性，而不是作為通用的默認選擇：對於基本工具使用，較簡單的 ReAct 風格或普通 SDK 迴圈可能更好，對於結構化提取和驗證則應使用以架構為先的工具，而當提示或程式優化是主要目標時，則應使用 DSPy。<lb/>每個配方解釋了何時 LangGraph 值得額外的結構，以及哪些實現模式使得路徑、暫停和審計追蹤成為明確的產品行為，而不是隱藏的提示邏輯。
